newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Hilasal started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Hilasal started as buy.

text.p: Caspian Research on Thursday said it began coverage of Mexican towel manufacturer Hilasal with a buy rating.
"We believe that improved operating efficiency and greater economics of scale will offset higher raw material prices, thereby increasing operating margins slightly," the analysts wrote in a report.
The brokerage estimated earnings per share of 3.5 U.S. cents for 1997, compared with 2.4 U.S. cents in 1996.
Export volumes are expected to increase by 85 percent, and greater domestic consumer spending should generate a 15 percent rise in domestic volumes, Caspian said.
Hilasal's licensing agreements should help sales, it added, noting that the company is the only producer for North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA) countries of reactive printed towels.
The company's shares stood at 3.10 pesos in late trade, up 0.20 peso from Wednesday's close.
